data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 7.9 million, primarily driven by unfavourable developments in Property, Third party liability, and Accident and Health classes, partially offset by favourable developments in other classes. The 2018 year of account also closed with a reported loss of GBP 55.7 million. The COVID-19 pandemic significantly impacted the 2018 and 2019 years of account, particularly the Contingency class, resulting in GBP 128 million net claims.
raw_causal_phrases: unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health
partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure of GBP 7.9m is assumed to be net of reinsurance as the narrative states 'Included within net claims incurred... is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m' and no explicit gross figure is provided. Claims development tables are distorted by RITC transactions, making them unreliable for calculating prior year development.
